column1: # Test: Edge-case break test. Deliberately stresses limits and conflicts to
#       surface real firmware bugs (clamping
#       arbitration). Every phase has a well-defined CORRECT outcome
#       failure is a genuine finding
# Slew physics: ~20 tenths per 100ms loop (200 deg x10 / sec). Steering clamps
#       to full lock: +250 tenths right (25 deg)
# NOTE on fields: actual_angle_tenths is the STEERING wheel angle (+/-250 max)
#       NOT the trike heading. heading_centiDeg is the trike's direction.
# Phase 1 (t=0):    command +400 -> must CLAMP to +250 (no overshoot / no wrap).
# Phase 2 (t=1400): command -400 -> a full +250 -> -250 reversal is 500 tenths
#                   (~2500ms) then clamps at left lock.
# Phase 3 (t=4100): command MAX throttle 3000 AND full brake 2 at once ->
#                   SAFE behavior is brake wins: vehicle must NOT accelerate.
#                   Also recenter the wheel to 0 and confirm it obeys.
# Format: time_ms
#   brake: 0=off
# Assertions use LOG fields: actual_angle_tenths
# Over-limit right must clamp to full lock
# assert t=1400: 240 <= actual_angle_tenths <= 250
# Max-span hard reversal (+250 -> -250 = 500 tenths) then clamp at left lock.
# assert t=4100: -250 <= actual_angle_tenths <= -240
# SAFETY: full throttle + full brake together -> brake must dominate (no accel).
# assert t=6800: sim_speed_cmPs < 20
# Wheel must also recenter despite the throttle/brake conflict.
# assert t=6800: -20 <= actual_angle_tenths <= 20
